purpose: prototype art preferences, not runtime game configuration

detail.actors: Prioritize silhouette, defining features, coherent planes, and restrained material cues.
detail.terrain: Quiet major masses and connected clusters; reserve strong contrast for actors.

animation.frame_budget: Use the fewest distinct poses that communicate the action, not a fixed frame count.
animation.physical_story: Support, load, drive, travel/contact, follow-through, braking, and settling.
animation.pose_rule: Pelvis, chest, shoulders, and head participate; do not animate limbs around a rigid trunk.

delivery.sprites: Preserve transparent canvas and partial-alpha shadows.
delivery.scenes: Composite source-over; complete-ground previews remain opaque.
delivery.inspection: Native size plus integer nearest-neighbor enlargement.
delivery.canvas: Allow transparent margins for equipment and motion; keep pixel density unchanged.
